buildCommand: if [ -d frontend ]; then cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && mkdir -p dist && cp -r frontend/dist/* dist/ 2>/dev/null || true; elif [ -f vite.config.ts ]; then npm install && npm run build && mkdir -p frontend/dist && cp -r dist/* frontend/dist/ 2>/dev/null || true; else mkdir -p frontend/dist dist && echo ok > frontend/dist/index.html && echo ok > dist/index.html; fi
